storylines.body: Washington Nationals 3, Philadelphia Phillies 6. Kyle Backhus earned the win. Key moment: Derek Hill hits a grand slam (9) to left center field. Bryan De La Cruz scores. Bryson Stott scores. Edmundo Sosa scores..
St. Louis Cardinals 13, New York Yankees 7. Gordon Graceffo earned the win. Key moment: Luis García Jr. homers (24) on a line drive to right center field. Trent Grisham scores..

The Pittsburgh Pirates edged the Milwaukee Brewers 4-3 behind Bubba Chandler's pitching and Mason Montgomery's save. Spencer Horwitz's two-out double in the third inning proved decisive, driving in three runs on a sharp grounder to right field as the Pirates broke open the game early. The Brewers mounted a comeback effort highlighted by Andrew Vaughn's line drive single in the sixth that scored two runs, but it fell just short as Montgomery recorded the final out with a strikeout of Brice Turang in the ninth.
